split_policy.note: `calibration` = SYNTH_KNOWN clips built only to obtain enough independent unit-onset events for the timing metric (spec §5 requires >= 50); they are not development fixtures for effect design. No holdout material exists yet, so every test is non-blind and must be reported as internal regression, not independent blind evaluation (spec §4/§5). Reserve future human-labelled clips as holdout before tuning on them.

truth_policy.HUMAN: independent human word/event labels — none available yet (timing acceptance NOT RUN)
truth_policy.SYNTH_KNOWN: per-unit TTS assembly with ffprobe-measured onsets — engineering calibration only, even for the `calibration` split
truth_policy.MACHINE_WEAK: ASR/model output — development regression only, never an independent truth
